description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface for the Rialto client, including factory methods, IPC channel management, event subscription, and control functions for a web audio player.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating WebAudioPlayer IPC instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Implementation of the factory for WebAudioPlayer IPC objects.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Main class implementing the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface, managing IPC communication, event subscription, and control commands.

methods.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the factory instance.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory::createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer IPC object with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC channel and creates the web audio player.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::~WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources, destroys the web audio player, and detaches the IPC channel.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::play
methods.description: Sends a play command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::pause
methods.description: Sends a pause command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::setEos
methods.description: Sends an end-of-stream command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the current web audio player instance.
